incidents.cause: An in-flight collision with a bald eagle.
The failure of airport personnel to correct a hazardous condition on the airport.  A factor was the uncovered manhole.
The tug crew’s inadequate visual lookout while towing an airplane at night and their failure to identify a stationary airplane within sufficient time/distance to stop.
The airplane’s impact with a bird while enroute.
A loss of aircraft control due to spatial disorientation.

The airplane’s collision with a bird during short final.
The accident airplane encountered jet blast from a departing Boeing 737.
An in-flight collision with a bird while entering the traffic pattern.
